mapper.sql: id, kind, ref_id, user_id, expected, actual, detail, status, created_at, resolved_by, resolved_at, note
mapper.select: SELECT id, chain, tx_hash, log_index, user_id, amount, status, block_number, block_hash, created_at FROM wallet_deposit WHERE status IN ('CREDITED', 'REVERSED')
SELECT id, user_id, deposit_id, amount, status FROM wallet_suspense
SELECT id, user_id, amount, status FROM wallet_withdrawal
SELECT chain, tx_hash, log_index, user_id, from_address, to_address, amount, kind FROM wallet_sweep_outflow WHERE kind <> 'SWEEP' ORDER BY id

SELECT b.chain, b.public_no, i.item_no, i.user_id, i.swept, (SELECT SUM(o.amount) FROM wallet_sweep_outflow o WHERE o.chain = b.chain AND o.tx_hash = b.tx_hash AND LOWER(o.from_address) = LOWER(i.address)) AS outflow FROM wallet_sweep_item i JOIN wallet_sweep_batch b ON b.id = i.batch_id JOIN wallet_chain_cursor c ON c.chain = b.chain WHERE i.status = 'SWEPT' AND b.block_number IS NOT NULL AND c.last_block >= b.block_number AND b.finished_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 30 DAY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallet_recon_issue WHERE kind = #{kind} AND ref_id = #{refId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallet_recon_issue WHERE kind = #{kind} AND ref_id = #{refId} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_recon_issue (kind, ref_id, user_id, expected, actual, detail) VALUES (#{kind}, #{refId}, #{userId}, #{expected}, #{actual}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wallet_recon_issue WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM wallet_recon_issue status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM wallet_recon_issue WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_recon_issue SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_by = #{adminId}, resolved_at = #{at}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE wallet_suspense SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = #{at}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
